artifact_inventory.role: brute-force verification of forward-orbit and cube-sterility lemmas

correctness.rationale: Lemma A verified: forward orbit {x+(a_1..a_6), a_i>=0} is the whole torus since +1 generates Z/nZ per coordinate, so only empty/full sets are forward-closed; cube witness v+(s-1,...,s-1) escaping via v+e_1 is correct including wrapped corners. Lemma B verified by missed-coordinate counting: outside x misses >=1 interval so at most one x+e_j can land in C (<2 needed), hence zero growers and [C]=C by induction; both cases |M|>=2 and |M|={j} are exhaustive and handle wraparound. s(n)=floor(F log n)<n eventually via log n<=2 sqrt(n) and N_0(F) bound is correct; s=0 case correctly noted as covering nothing and always present. Auditor re-executed verify_droplet_lemmas.py: all cases pass with max<=1 forward neighbour and zero growers. The conjunction refutation follows: the droplet clause (closed + layer-by-layer expansion + covering >=1-n^{-2}) is unsatisfiable for every F>0 along every n_k->infinity, uniformly in p.

originality.rationale: Fused live retrieval (SerpBase/Serpent Top 10/20, OpenAlex/Crossref Top 15, OpenAIRE; partial=false) returns only standard undirected r-neighbour thresholds (Holroyd 2D, Balogh-Bollobas-Morris 3D/high-D, Duminil-Copin/Morris all dimensions, Cerf-Cirillo finite-size scaling) and distinct directed families (anisotropic, Duarte, DTBP/Spiral, U-bootstrap universality, Hamming torus/hypercube). None states or implies the forward-2 torus rule, the only-empty/full forward-closed classification on T_n^6, or cube sterility [C]=C. Equivalent U-bootstrap/directed encodings, broader threshold/classification theorems, and exact database/table lookups were each tested in decisive_checks with no coverage; domination only gives a window inequality, not droplet impossibility. The headline is substantively new, not a rename, recomputation, corollary, or special case of a stronger fact.

value.rationale: TARGET route: rigorous disproof of the full SF6 conjunction via its droplet clause is a complete resolution, and it is not a cheap defect. It is uniform over every explicit F>0 and every sequence n_k->infinity (not a small-instance mismatch), deterministic rather than a lookup, and exposes a structural incompatibility between periodic geometry plus forward orientation and the proposed cube mechanism (closure forces full torus; sterility forces zero growth), generalizing to all d>=2, r>=2. The object and invariant were motivated before computation by the admitted target, the facts were not known or mechanically implied by standard undirected-threshold results, and a future researcher could reasonably need them to avoid re-pursuing forward cube droplets. No ADMISSION_DEFECT: the droplet clause was not facially vacuous without Lemmas A/B. Passes the shared STANDARD without imposing a paper-level general-theorem requirement.

broader_coverage.evidence: The nearest broader theorems are Balogh-Bollobas-Morris high-dimensional bounds, Duminil-Copin/Morris sharp threshold for every d>r>2, Cerf-Cirillo/Cerf-Manzo Theta-bounds, and Bollobas-Smith-Uzzel/Hartarsky U-bootstrap universality (subcritical/critical/supercritical). All assume undirected r-neighbourhoods on [n]^d or general U on Z^d and conclude threshold asymptotics or classification; none quantifies forward-only neighbourhoods x+e_i on the periodic torus T_n^6 or any cube-droplet covering clause at side floor(F log n).
broader_coverage.reasoning: Hypotheses differ on neighbourhood (2d undirected neighbours vs 6 forward neighbours), geometry (grid/box vs periodic torus where forward orbits wrap), and conclusion (existence of a window vs impossibility of the conjoined forward-closed expanding droplet). A broader threshold theorem therefore cannot substantively imply the submitted impossibility of cubes; no dominance query returned a census or classification covering T_n^6 forward-2 droplets as a special case.
broader_coverage.search: Searched dominance direction: stronger sharp-threshold theorem, broader object class, larger parameter range, exhaustive census or classification, and established databases that could cover forward-2 on 6D torus cubes as a special case.

claim_vs_prior_implication.evidence: Prior conclusions are positive threshold asymptotics (e.g. pc ~ lambda/log^5 n style for standard 2-neighbour in 6D) and critical-droplet growth mechanisms for undirected rules. The submitted headline is a negative droplet impossibility: [C]=C with zero deterministic growth and non-closedness for every proper cube, uniformly in F and p. The only logical bridge, neighbourhood-inclusion domination (forward infection implies standard infection, noted in topic.json), yields a one-sided probability inequality, not the dynamical sterility or closure facts.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: No prior result substantively implies the headline: threshold asymptotics do not entail that proper cubes are non-forward-closed or sterile under the forward-2 update, and domination points the wrong way (it constrains the window, not the droplet mechanism). Title or embedding similarity to standard bootstrap percolation therefore does not establish coverage; literal hypothesis-conclusion comparison shows non-implication.
claim_vs_prior_implication.search: Compared submitted theorem hypotheses and conclusions literally against the nearest prior bootstrap-percolation threshold and droplet-growth results to test substantive implication versus mere topic similarity.

equivalent_formulations.evidence: Fused results contain distinct directed/anisotropic lines (Duminil-Copin/van Enter anisotropic model, Duarte/DTBP/Spiral U-bootstrap models, Hartarsky subcritical critical-densities, Balister-Bollobas-Przykucki-Smith subcritical work) but no source using the forward-2 rule (infection from x+e_1..x+e_6 only) on T_n^6, and no source stating that proper cubes are non-forward-closed or bootstrap-sterile. U-bootstrap encoding with update family of 2-subsets of {e_i} was considered and no prior table or theorem instantiates this family on the torus with cube droplets.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Synonymous names (oriented/directed/forward), dual/complement/incidence-graph/matrix encodings, and U-bootstrap update-family reformulations were all tested against the fused set. None changes the neighbourhood or geometry to match: prior directed models use different update families and infinite-lattice settings, so none covers the exact forward-2 torus cube claim even up to renaming.
